zephaniah-prophet.name: Zephaniah, son of Cushi
zephaniah-prophet.role: Prophet whose book opens during Josiah’s reign
zephaniah-prophet.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
zephaniah-prophet.importance: His warning confronts indifference before the ending promises to gather afflicted people.
zephaniah-prophet.connections: The opening traces his family through Cushi, Gedaliah, Amariah, and Hezekiah.

josiah.name: Josiah
josiah.role: King named in the book’s opening time reference
josiah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
josiah.importance: His name gives the opening a royal setting without dating every later vision.
josiah.connections: He is Amon’s son and king of Judah when the opening places Zephaniah’s message.
